data:
@CategoryTheory.ihom.{u_1,
    u_2} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{u_1, u_2} C inst] →
      (A : C) →
        [@CategoryTheory.Closed.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1 A] → @CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_2} C inst C inst

@CategoryTheory.ihom.adjunction.{u_1,
    u_2} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{u_1, u_2} C inst] →
      (A : C) →
        [inst_2 : @CategoryTheory.Closed.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1 A] →
          @CategoryTheory.Adjunction.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_2} C inst C inst
            (@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1 A)
            (@CategoryTheory.ihom.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1 A inst_2)

@CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.curry.{u_1,
    u_2} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{u_1, u_2} C inst] →
      {A X Y : C} →
        [inst_2 : @CategoryTheory.Closed.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1 A] →
          @Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_2} C
              (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_1, u_2} C
                (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst))
              (@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj.{u_1, u_2} C inst
                (@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.toMonoidalCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1) A Y)
              X →
            @Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_2} C
              (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_1, u_2} C
                (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst))
              Y
              (@CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_2} C inst C inst
                (@CategoryTheory.ihom.{u_1, u_2} C inst inst_1 A inst_2) X)

@CategoryTheory.Closed.{u_1,
    u_2} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    [@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{u_1, u_2} C inst] → C → Type (max u_2 u_1)

CategoryTheory.MonoidalClosed.{u_1,
  u_2} : (C : Type u_2) →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    [@CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.{u_1, u_2} C inst] → Type (max u_2 u_1)
